scope: All 33 units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The Vedic text and its accents were not compared with the source. The three low-match flags (units 11, 25, 32) are sandhi and a repeated refrain glossed once.

items.issue: brahmaṇaspatiḥ is nominative: he purifies. The translation had the waters purifying “the Lord of the Veda”.
items.change: Now “May the Lord of the sacred word purify; may she, purified by the sacred word, purify me.”

items.issue: idaṃ brahma juṣasva naḥ is “accept this prayer of ours”; it was “make this Brahman welcome to us”.
The gloss left out jyotiṣi and put juhomi svāhā in brackets.
anīkam was glossed “host”; here it is the face (of the gods), as the translation has.
riripuḥ … na dīvi was glossed “what they cheat … in play”.
items.change: Now “whatever they have laid to our charge … as at dice”, matching the translation.

items.issue: The gloss had etasmin for the text’s etasyām.
